class HostService: 
 49class HostService:
 50    """
 51    主机业务逻辑服务
 52
 53    Args:
 54        repository: 主机配置仓库
 55        credential_provider: 凭据提供者（可选）
 56        encryption: 密码加密器（可选）
 57        ssh_service: SSH 连接服务（可选，自动创建）
 58        profile_store: Profile 存储（可选）。未提供时，若 repository 实现了
 59            :class:`ProfileStore` 能力协议则自动采用；均不满足时引用 profile
 60            的主机会在解析时报 ConfigError
 61    """
 62
 63    def __init__(
 64        self,
 65        repository: HostRepository,
 66        credential_provider: Optional[CredentialProvider] = None,
 67        encryption: Optional[CredentialEncryption] = None,
 68        ssh_service: Optional[SSHService] = None,
 69        profile_store: Optional[ProfileStore] = None,
 70    ) -> None:
 71        self._repo = repository
 72        self._encryption = encryption or CredentialEncryption()
 73        self._ssh = ssh_service or SSHService()
 74        if profile_store is not None:
 75            self._profile_store: Optional[ProfileStore] = profile_store
 76        elif isinstance(repository, ProfileStore):
 77            self._profile_store = repository
 78        else:
 79            self._profile_store = None
 80
 81        if credential_provider:
 82            self._cred_provider = credential_provider
 83        else:
 84            # 默认凭据链: 环境变量 → 加密文件
 85            self._cred_provider = ChainCredentialProvider(
 86                [
 87                    EnvCredentialProvider(),
 88                    EncryptedFileCredentialProvider(repository, self._encryption),
 89                ]
 90            )
 91
 92    # ========================================================================
 93    # 主机管理
 94    # ========================================================================
 95
 96    def add_host(self, host: Host) -> Host:
 97        """
 98        添加主机
 99
100        Args:
101            host: 主机配置
102
103        Returns:
104            Host: 已添加的主机
105
106        Raises:
107            ValueError: 同名主机已存在
108        """
109        if self._repo.contains(host.name):
110            raise ValueError(f"Host '{host.name}' already exists")
111
112        # 加密密码（如果明文）
113        if host.password and not self._encryption.is_encrypted(host.password):
114            host.password = self._encryption.encrypt(host.password)
115
116        self._repo.save(host)
117        self._repo.flush()
118        logger.info(f"host added: {host.name}")
119        return host
120
121    def get_host(self, name: str) -> Host:
122        """获取主机配置（合并 profile 连接默认值，密码自动解密）"""
123        host = self._repo.get(name)
124        return self._decrypt_host(self._apply_profile(host))
125
126    def update_host(self, name: str, **kwargs: Any) -> Host:
127        """
128        更新主机配置
129
130        Args:
131            name: 主机名
132            **kwargs: 要更新的字段
133
134        Returns:
135            Host: 更新后的主机
136        """
137        host = self._repo.get(name)
138        for key, value in kwargs.items():
139            if hasattr(host, key):
140                setattr(host, key, value)
141
142        # 如果密码被更新，重新加密
143        if (
144            "password" in kwargs
145            and kwargs["password"] is not None
146            and not self._encryption.is_encrypted(kwargs["password"])
147        ):
148            host.password = self._encryption.encrypt(kwargs["password"])
149
150        self._repo.save(host)
151        self._repo.flush()
152        logger.info(f"host updated: {name}")
153        return host
154
155    def remove_host(self, name: str) -> None:
156        """删除主机"""
157        self._repo.delete(name)
158        self._repo.flush()
159        logger.info(f"host removed: {name}")
160
161    def list_hosts(self, tag: Optional[str] = None) -> list[Host]:
162        """列出主机（合并 profile 连接默认值，密码自动解密）。
163
164        ``tag`` 过滤基于**合并后**的标签（主机标签 + profile 标签）。
165        """
166        hosts = [self._decrypt_host(self._apply_profile(h)) for h in self._repo.list()]
167        if tag:
168            hosts = [h for h in hosts if h.tags and tag in h.tags]
169        return hosts
170
171    def list_tags(self) -> list[str]:
172        """列出所有标签（主机标签 + 全部 profile 标签的并集）"""
173        tags = set(self._repo.list_tags())
174        if self._profile_store is not None:
175            for profile in self._profile_store.list_profiles():
176                tags.update(profile.tags)
177        return sorted(tags)
178
179    # ========================================================================
180    # 连接管理
181    # ========================================================================
182
183    def connect_to_host(self, name: str) -> SSHClient:
184        """
185        建立到主机的 SSH 连接
186
187        Args:
188            name: 主机名
189
190        Returns:
191            SSHClient: 已连接的客户端
192        """
193        host = self.resolve_host(name)
194        return self._ssh.create_client(**self._to_ssh_args(host))
195
196    def test_connection(self, name: str) -> bool:
197        """
198        测试主机连接
199
200        Args:
201            name: 主机名
202
203        Returns:
204            bool: True if connected
205        """
206        host = self.resolve_host(name)
207        return self._ssh.test_connection(**self._to_ssh_args(host))
208
209    def test_all_connections(self, max_workers: int = 10) -> dict[str, bool]:
210        """并行测试所有主机连接"""
211        from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed
212
213        hosts = self._repo.list()
214        results: dict[str, bool] = {}
215
216        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=max_workers) as executor:
217            future_map = {executor.submit(self.test_connection, h.name): h.name for h in hosts}
218            for future in as_completed(future_map):
219                name = future_map[future]
220                try:
221                    results[name] = future.result()
222                except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
223                    logger.error(f"connection test error for host {name}: {e}")
224                    results[name] = False
225
226        return results
227
228    def _build_resolved_host(
229        self,
230        host: Host,
231        password: Optional[str],
232        key_filename: Optional[str],
233    ) -> Host:
234        """构造带解析后凭据的 Host 副本，绝不修改仓库内存中的原对象。
235
236        Args:
237            host: 仓库中的原始主机对象
238            password: 解析后的密码（明文或加密 token）
239            key_filename: 解析后的私钥路径
240
241        Returns:
242            Host: 新副本
243        """
244        return Host(
245            name=host.name,
246            hostname=host.hostname,
247            username=host.username,
248            port=host.port,
249            password=password,
250            key_filename=key_filename,
251            tags=host.tags,
252            description=host.description,
253            profile=host.profile,
254        )
255
256    def _apply_profile(self, host: Host) -> Host:
257        """合并主机引用的 profile 连接默认值（引用式，v2.8）。
258
259        语义（profile 为回退层，主机优先；详见 ``core/profile.py``）：
260        - ``username``：主机为空时由 profile 提供
261        - ``port``：主机为默认值 22 时由 profile 提供（显式非默认端口优先）
262        - ``key_filename``：主机为 None 时由 profile 提供
263        - ``tags``：主机标签 + profile 标签（并集去重，主机顺序在前）
264        - ``description``：主机为空字符串时由 profile 提供
265
266        Returns:
267            Host: 合并后的新副本（绝不修改仓库内存中的原对象）
268
269        Raises:
270            ConfigError: 仓库不支持 profile 或引用了未知 profile
271        """
272        if not host.profile:
273            return host
274        if self._profile_store is None:
275            raise ConfigError(
276                f"host '{host.name}' references profile '{host.profile}' "
277                "but the repository does not support profiles"
278            )
279        try:
280            profile = self._profile_store.get_profile(host.profile)
281        except KeyError:
282            raise ConfigError(
283                f"host '{host.name}' references unknown profile '{host.profile}'"
284            ) from None
285
286        username = host.username or profile.username or host.username
287        port = (
288            profile.port
289            if profile.port is not None and host.port == DEFAULT_PORT
290            else host.port
291        )
292        key_filename = host.key_filename if host.key_filename is not None else profile.key_filename
293        tags = list(host.tags)
294        for tag in profile.tags:
295            if tag not in tags:
296                tags.append(tag)
297        description = host.description or profile.description
298
299        return Host(
300            name=host.name,
301            hostname=host.hostname,
302            username=username,
303            port=port,
304            password=host.password,
305            key_filename=key_filename,
306            tags=tags,
307            description=description,
308            profile=host.profile,
309        )
310
311    def _to_ssh_args(self, host: Host) -> dict[str, Any]:
312        """从主机构造 SSH 服务的连接参数字典（create_client / test_connection 共用）。"""
313        return {
314            "hostname": host.hostname,
315            "username": host.username,
316            "port": host.port,
317            "password": host.password,
318            "key_filename": host.key_filename,
319        }
320
321    def _decrypt_host(self, host: Host) -> Host:
322        """返回主机副本，密码字段自动解密（如已加密）"""
323        if host.password and self._encryption.is_encrypted(host.password):
324            try:
325                decrypted = self._encryption.decrypt(host.password)
326                return self._build_resolved_host(host, decrypted, host.key_filename)
327            except CredentialEncryptionError as e:
328                # 解密失败不应阻塞整批主机返回：保留加密 token，
329                # 让 SSH 层在真正连接时报告认证失败
330                logger.warning(f"failed to decrypt password for {host.name}: {e}")
331        return host
332
333    def resolve_host(self, name: str) -> Host:
334        """
335        获取主机并尝试解密密码
336
337        解密优先级：
338        1. 通过凭据提供链（环境变量 / keyring / 加密文件存储等）获取明文
339        2. 若凭据链未命中，则回退到本地 CredentialEncryption 解密存储中的加密 token
340
341        这一层兜底是必需的：CLI 的默认凭据链可能不包含
342        EncryptedFileCredentialProvider，但主机密码已被 add_host 加密落盘，
343        若不兜底解密则 connect_to_host 会拿到加密 token 当密码使用，必然认证失败。
344
345        Note:
346            本方法返回一个新的 Host 副本，绝不就地修改仓库内存中存储的对象。
347            若直接修改 repo.get() 返回的原始引用，解密后的明文密码会污染内存
348            中的加密 token，后续任意 add_host/update_host/remove_host 触发
349            flush() 时明文密码会被写入磁盘，造成凭据泄露。
350
351        Note (v2.8):
352            返回的是**合并 profile 后**的有效配置（引用式解析）。
353        """
354        host = self._apply_profile(self._repo.get(name))
355
356        # 解析密码：始终写入新变量，不修改 host 原对象
357        resolved_password = host.password
358        if host.password and self._encryption.is_encrypted(host.password):
359            resolved = self._cred_provider.get_password(host)
360            if resolved:
361                resolved_password = resolved
362            else:
363                # 凭据链未命中，回退到本地加密器解密
364                try:
365                    resolved_password = self._encryption.decrypt(host.password)
366                except CredentialEncryptionError as e:
367                    logger.warning(f"failed to decrypt password for {host.name}: {e}")
368                    # 保留加密 token，留给 SSH 层报认证失败
369
370        # 解析密钥路径
371        resolved_key_filename = host.key_filename
372        if resolved_key_filename:
373            resolved_key_filename = str(Path(resolved_key_filename).expanduser())
374
375        # 返回新对象，保持仓库内存中的加密 token 不被污染
376        return self._build_resolved_host(host, resolved_password, resolved_key_filename)

335        获取主机并尝试解密密码
336
337        解密优先级：
338        1. 通过凭据提供链（环境变量 / keyring / 加密文件存储等）获取明文
339        2. 若凭据链未命中，则回退到本地 CredentialEncryption 解密存储中的加密 token
340
341        这一层兜底是必需的：CLI 的默认凭据链可能不包含
342        EncryptedFileCredentialProvider，但主机密码已被 add_host 加密落盘，
343        若不兜底解密则 connect_to_host 会拿到加密 token 当密码使用，必然认证失败。
344
345        Note:
346            本方法返回一个新的 Host 副本，绝不就地修改仓库内存中存储的对象。
347            若直接修改 repo.get() 返回的原始引用，解密后的明文密码会污染内存
348            中的加密 token，后续任意 add_host/update_host/remove_host 触发
349            flush() 时明文密码会被写入磁盘，造成凭据泄露。
350
351        Note (v2.8):
352            返回的是**合并 profile 后**的有效配置（引用式解析）。
353        """
354        host = self._apply_profile(self._repo.get(name))
355
356        # 解析密码：始终写入新变量，不修改 host 原对象
357        resolved_password = host.password
358        if host.password and self._encryption.is_encrypted(host.password):
359            resolved = self._cred_provider.get_password(host)
360            if resolved:
361                resolved_password = resolved
362            else:
363                # 凭据链未命中，回退到本地加密器解密
364                try:
365                    resolved_password = self._encryption.decrypt(host.password)
366                except CredentialEncryptionError as e:
367                    logger.warning(f"failed to decrypt password for {host.name}: {e}")
368                    # 保留加密 token，留给 SSH 层报认证失败
369
370        # 解析密钥路径
371        resolved_key_filename = host.key_filename
372        if resolved_key_filename:
373            resolved_key_filename = str(Path(resolved_key_filename).expanduser())
374
375        # 返回新对象，保持仓库内存中的加密 token 不被污染
376        return self._build_resolved_host(host, resolved_password, resolved_key_filename)

获取主机并尝试解密密码

解密优先级：

  1. 通过凭据提供链（环境变量 / keyring / 加密文件存储等）获取明文
  2. 若凭据链未命中，则回退到本地 CredentialEncryption 解密存储中的加密 token

这一层兜底是必需的：CLI 的默认凭据链可能不包含 EncryptedFileCredentialProvider，但主机密码已被 add_host 加密落盘， 若不兜底解密则 connect_to_host 会拿到加密 token 当密码使用，必然认证失败。

Note: 本方法返回一个新的 Host 副本，绝不就地修改仓库内存中存储的对象。 若直接修改 repo.get() 返回的原始引用，解密后的明文密码会污染内存 中的加密 token，后续任意 add_host/update_host/remove_host 触发 flush() 时明文密码会被写入磁盘，造成凭据泄露。

Note (v2.8): 返回的是合并 profile 后的有效配置（引用式解析）。

class ProfileService: 
 31class ProfileService:
 32    """Profile 管理服务。
 33
 34    Args:
 35        store: Profile 存储（实现 ProfileStore 协议的仓库）
 36        host_repository: 可选的主机仓库，用于删除时的引用检查
 37    """
 38
 39    def __init__(
 40        self,
 41        store: ProfileStore,
 42        host_repository: Optional[HostRepository] = None,
 43    ) -> None:
 44        self._store = store
 45        self._hosts = host_repository
 46
 47    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
 48    # CRUD
 49    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
 50    def add_profile(self, profile: HostProfile) -> HostProfile:
 51        """新增 profile。
 52
 53        Raises:
 54            ValueError: 同名 profile 已存在
 55        """
 56        if self._store.contains_profile(profile.name):
 57            raise ValueError(f"profile '{profile.name}' already exists")
 58        self._store.save_profile(profile)
 59        self._flush()
 60        logger.info(f"profile added: {profile.name}")
 61        return profile
 62
 63    def update_profile(self, profile_name: str, **kwargs: Any) -> HostProfile:
 64        """更新 profile 字段（不存在时 KeyError）。
 65
 66        仅更新 HostProfile 已有的字段；``name`` 本身不可改名
 67        （通过 ``name=...`` 传入会抛 ValueError）。
 68        """
 69        profile = self._store.get_profile(profile_name)
 70        data = profile.to_dict()
 71        for key, value in kwargs.items():
 72            if key == "name":
 73                raise ValueError("profile name cannot be changed; remove and re-add instead")
 74            if key in data:
 75                data[key] = value
 76        # 先构造校验副本（非法值抛 ValidationError，不污染存储中的对象）
 77        validated = HostProfile.from_dict(data)
 78        self._store.save_profile(validated)
 79        self._flush()
 80        logger.info(f"profile updated: {profile_name}")
 81        return validated
 82
 83    def remove_profile(self, name: str, force: bool = False) -> None:
 84        """删除 profile。
 85
 86        Args:
 87            name: profile 名称
 88            force: 为 False（默认）且提供了 host_repository 时，
 89                若仍有主机引用该 profile 则抛出 ValueError
 90
 91        Raises:
 92            KeyError: profile 不存在
 93            ValueError: 仍被主机引用且未 force
 94        """
 95        self._store.get_profile(name)  # 不存在 -> KeyError
 96        if not force and self._hosts is not None:
 97            referencing = [h.name for h in self._hosts.list() if h.profile == name]
 98            if referencing:
 99                names = ", ".join(sorted(referencing))
100                raise ValueError(
101                    f"profile '{name}' is still referenced by hosts: {names}; "
102                    "pass force=True (or remove the references first)"
103                )
104        self._store.delete_profile(name)
105        self._flush()
106        logger.info(f"profile removed: {name}")
107
108    def get_profile(self, name: str) -> HostProfile:
109        return self._store.get_profile(name)
110
111    def list_profiles(self) -> list[HostProfile]:
112        return self._store.list_profiles()
113
114    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
115    # 内部
116    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
117    def _flush(self) -> None:
118        """仓库支持 flush（JSON）时落盘；SQLite 写入即时生效则跳过。"""
119        flush = getattr(self._store, "flush", None)
120        if callable(flush):
121            flush()

class SSHService: 
 21class SSHService:
 22    """
 23    SSH 连接服务
 24
 25    提供连接管理、命令执行和健康检查功能。
 26    支持重试和超时控制。
 27    """
 28
 29    def __init__(self, timeout: int = 30) -> None:
 30        self._timeout = timeout
 31
 32    def create_client(
 33        self,
 34        hostname: str,
 35        username: str,
 36        port: int = 22,
 37        password: Optional[str] = None,
 38        key_filename: Optional[str] = None,
 39        known_hosts_file: Optional[str] = None,
 40    ) -> SSHClient:
 41        """
 42        创建并建立 SSH 连接
 43
 44        Returns:
 45            已连接的 SSHClient 实例
 46
 47        Raises:
 48            SSHConnectionError: 连接失败
 49        """
 50        config = ConnectionConfig(
 51            hostname=hostname,
 52            username=username,
 53            port=port,
 54            password=password,
 55            key_filename=key_filename,
 56            timeout=self._timeout,
 57            known_hosts_file=known_hosts_file,
 58        )
 59        client = SSHClient(config)
 60        return client.connect()
 61
 62    def test_connection(
 63        self,
 64        hostname: str,
 65        username: str,
 66        port: int = 22,
 67        password: Optional[str] = None,
 68        key_filename: Optional[str] = None,
 69    ) -> bool:
 70        """
 71        测试主机连接是否正常
 72
 73        Returns:
 74            bool: True if connected
 75        """
 76        try:
 77            with self.create_client(
 78                hostname=hostname,
 79                username=username,
 80                port=port,
 81                password=password,
 82                key_filename=key_filename,
 83            ) as client:
 84                return client.is_connected()
 85        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
 86            logger.debug(f"connection test failed {hostname}:{port}: {e}")
 87            return False
 88
 89    def execute_command(
 90        self,
 91        hostname: str,
 92        username: str,
 93        command: str,
 94        port: int = 22,
 95        password: Optional[str] = None,
 96        key_filename: Optional[str] = None,
 97        timeout: Optional[int] = None,
 98    ) -> CommandResult:
 99        """
100        在远程主机上执行命令
101
102        Returns:
103            CommandResult: 命令执行结果
104        """
105        with self.create_client(
106            hostname=hostname,
107            username=username,
108            port=port,
109            password=password,
110            key_filename=key_filename,
111        ) as client:
112            return client.execute(command, timeout=timeout)

class EnvCredentialProvider(remote_cmd.CredentialProvider): 
 62class EnvCredentialProvider(CredentialProvider):
 63    """
 64    从环境变量获取密码
 65
 66    适用于 CI/CD 或容器环境。
 67    优先级低于交互式输入但高于默认值。
 68
 69    支持两种查找方式（按优先级）：
 70    1. 主机专属变量 ``<env_var>_<HOST>``（主机名大写，非字母数字替换为 ``_``）
 71    2. 全局变量 ``<env_var>``
 72
 73    示例：
 74        - 全局：``REMOTE_CMD_PASSWORD=secret`` 对所有主机生效
 75        - 专属：``REMOTE_CMD_PASSWORD_WEB1=secret`` 仅对名为 ``web1`` 的主机生效
 76
 77    Args:
 78        env_var: 环境变量名（默认 REMOTE_CMD_PASSWORD）
 79    """
 80
 81    def __init__(self, env_var: str = "REMOTE_CMD_PASSWORD") -> None:
 82        self._env_var = env_var
 83
 84    @staticmethod
 85    def _host_env_suffix(host_name: str) -> str:
 86        """
 87        将主机名转换为环境变量后缀：web1 -> WEB1，my-host -> MY_HOST
 88
 89        注意: 非字母数字字符统一归一化为下划线，因此 ``web-1`` 与 ``web_1``
 90        会映射到同一个变量 ``..._WEB_1``。若同舰队同时存在这两种命名，
 91        需避免依赖同名变量（如需区分请先统一主机命名规范）。
 92        """
 93        normalized = "".join(c if c.isalnum() else "_" for c in host_name).upper()
 94        return normalized
 95
 96    def get_password(self, host: Host) -> Optional[str]:
 97        # 优先主机专属变量，避免全局变量被应用到所有主机
 98        if host and host.name:
 99            host_var = f"{self._env_var}_{self._host_env_suffix(host.name)}"
100            host_password = os.environ.get(host_var)
101            if host_password is not None:
102                return host_password
103        return os.environ.get(self._env_var)

133class ChainCredentialProvider(CredentialProvider):
134    """
135    链式凭据提供者
136
137    按顺序尝试每个提供者，返回第一个非空结果。
138    适用于 "环境变量 → 加密文件 → 交互式输入" 的优先级链。
139

142    """
143
144    def __init__(self, providers: list[CredentialProvider]) -> None:
145        self._providers = list(providers)
146
147    def get_password(self, host: Host) -> Optional[str]:
148        for provider in self._providers:
149            password = provider.get_password(host)
150            if password is not None:
151                return password
152        return None
153
154    def add_provider(self, provider: CredentialProvider) -> None:
155        """在链尾添加一个提供者"""
156        self._providers.append(provider)

class CredentialEncryption: 
 48class CredentialEncryption:
 49    """
 50    Fernet 凭据加解密器
 51
 52    使用 cryptography.fernet 实现对称加密。
 53    密钥自动管理：首次加密时生成，后续自动加载。
 54
 55    Attributes:
 56        key_path: 密钥文件存储路径
 57    """
 58
 59    _PREFIX = "$encrypted$"
 60
 61    def __init__(self, key_path: Optional[Path] = None) -> None:
 62        """
 63        Args:
 64            key_path: 密钥文件路径，默认 ~/.remote_cmd/.key
 65        """
 66        self._key_path = key_path or (Path.home() / ".remote_cmd" / ".key")
 67        self._fernet: Optional[Fernet] = None
 68
 69    @property
 70    def _cipher(self) -> "Fernet":
 71        """延迟初始化 Fernet 实例"""
 72        if self._fernet is None:
 73            key = self._load_or_create_key()
 74            from cryptography.fernet import Fernet
 75
 76            self._fernet = Fernet(key)
 77        return self._fernet
 78
 79    def encrypt(self, plaintext: str) -> str:
 80        """
 81        加密明文密码
 82
 83        Args:
 84            plaintext: 明文密码
 85
 86        Returns:
 87            str: Base64 编码的密文字符串（格式: $encrypted$<token>）
 88
 89        Raises:
 90            CredentialEncryptionError: 加密失败
 91        """
 92        try:
 93            token = self._cipher.encrypt(plaintext.encode("utf-8"))
 94            return self._PREFIX + token.decode("utf-8")
 95        except (TypeError, ValueError) as e:
 96            raise CredentialEncryptionError(f"encryption failed: {e}") from e
 97
 98    def decrypt(self, ciphertext: str) -> str:
 99        """
100        解密密文
101
102        Args:
103            ciphertext: 加密后的密文字符串
104
105        Returns:
106            str: 明文密码
107
108        Raises:
109            CredentialEncryptionError: 解密失败或格式错误
110        """
111        if not ciphertext.startswith(self._PREFIX):
112            raise CredentialEncryptionError("invalid ciphertext format")
113
114        from cryptography.fernet import InvalidToken
115
116        try:
117            token = ciphertext[len(self._PREFIX) :].encode("utf-8")
118            return self._cipher.decrypt(token).decode("utf-8")
119        # InvalidToken：签名/内容损坏；ValueError（含 binascii.Error）：
120        # base64/格式非法；TypeError：token 类型错误。其余异常（如密钥加载
121        # 缺陷或 cryptography 内部错误）向上传播，不再伪装为"解密失败"。
122        except (InvalidToken, ValueError, TypeError) as e:
123            raise CredentialEncryptionError(f"decryption failed: {e}") from e
124
125    def is_encrypted(self, value: str) -> bool:
126        """
127        检查字符串是否为加密格式
128
129        采用双重校验降低格式碰撞风险：
130        1. 前缀匹配 ``$encrypted$``
131        2. token 部分必须是 Fernet 格式（version byte 0x80，base64 编码后以 ``g`` 开头，
132           且解码后总长度至少 57 字节 = 1 + 8 + 16 + 32）
133
134        这避免了与真实密码恰好以 ``$encrypted$`` 开头时被误判的场景：
135        真实密码很少以 ``$encrypted$g`` 开头，且 base64 解码长度必须 >= 57 字节。
136
137        Attention: 本函数不验证 HMAC/签名，仅为廉价标识符检测；
138        完整合法性校验在 :meth:`decrypt` 中完成。
139        """
140        if not value.startswith(self._PREFIX):
141            return False
142        token = value[len(self._PREFIX) :]
143        # Fernet token base64 解码后第一字节恒为 0x80（编码后开头为 "g"）
144        if not token.startswith("g"):
145            return False
146        # 重新填充 base64 并解码长度校验，避免误判纯字符串
147        import base64
148
149        padding = "=" * (-len(token) % 4)
150        try:
151            decoded = base64.urlsafe_b64decode(token + padding)
152        except ValueError:
153            return False
154        # 最小密文长度 = version(1) + timestamp(8) + IV(16) + HMAC(32)
155        return len(decoded) >= 57
156
157    def _load_or_create_key(self) -> bytes:
158        """
159        加载现有密钥或生成新密钥
160
161        密钥文件权限设为 0600，防止其他用户读取。
162        校验密钥格式：必须是合法的 Fernet key（32 字节 base64 编码）。
163        """
164        from cryptography.fernet import Fernet
165
166        if self._key_path.exists():
167            # 确保现有密钥文件权限正确
168            try:
169                current_perms = stat_module.S_IMODE(self._key_path.stat().st_mode)
170                if current_perms != 0o600:
171                    self._key_path.chmod(0o600)
172            except OSError:
173                pass  # Windows 或权限不足时忽略
174
175            key = self._key_path.read_bytes()
176            # 校验密钥格式：Fernet key 必须是 32 字节 base64 编码（44 字符，含 padding）
177            try:
178                decoded = base64.urlsafe_b64decode(key)
179                if len(decoded) != 32:
180                    raise ValueError(f"Invalid key length: {len(decoded)} bytes, expected 32")
181            except (ValueError, binascii.Error) as e:
182                logger.error(f"Invalid encryption key format at {self._key_path}: {e}")
183                raise CredentialEncryptionError(
184                    f"Corrupted or invalid key file: {self._key_path}. "
185                    f"Delete it to regenerate, or check permissions."
186                ) from e
187
188            return key
189
190        # 生成新密钥
191        key = Fernet.generate_key()
192        self._key_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
193        # 安全：原子创建密钥文件并直接设置 0600 权限，避免 write_bytes（受 umask
194        # 影响，默认可能为 0644）与 chmod(0600) 之间的 TOCTOU 窗口——在此窗口内
195        # 同机其他用户可读取主加密密钥，进而解密所有凭据。
196        # O_EXCL 同时消除多进程并发首次创建时互相覆盖密钥的竞态。
197        try:
198            fd = os.open(
199                str(self._key_path),
200                os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL,
201                0o600,
202            )
203        except FileExistsError:
204            # 并发首次创建：另一进程已生成密钥，重新加载
205            return self._load_or_create_key()
206        try:
207            os.write(fd, key)
208        finally:
209            os.close(fd)
210
211        logger.info(f"generated encryption key: {self._key_path}")
212        return key

Fernet 凭据加解密器

使用 cryptography.fernet 实现对称加密。 密钥自动管理：首次加密时生成，后续自动加载。

def setup_logging( level: str = 'INFO', log_file: Optional[str] = None, max_bytes: int = 10485760, backup_count: int = 5, structured: bool = False, verbose: bool = False) -> None: 
102def setup_logging(
103    level: str = "INFO",
104    log_file: Optional[str] = None,
105    max_bytes: int = 10 * 1024 * 1024,  # 10MB
106    backup_count: int = 5,
107    structured: bool = False,
108    verbose: bool = False,
109) -> None:
110    """
111    配置统一日志系统
112
113    Args:
114        level: 日志级别 (DEBUG/INFO/WARNING/ERROR/CRITICAL)
115        log_file: 日志文件路径（可选，不指定时只输出到控制台）
116        max_bytes: 单个日志文件最大字节数
117        backup_count: 保留的轮转文件数
118        structured: 是否使用 JSON 结构化格式
119        verbose: 是否启用详细格式
120    """
121    root_logger = logging.getLogger()
122    root_logger.setLevel(getattr(logging, level.upper(), logging.INFO))
123
124    # 清除已有处理器：先关闭再移除，避免遗留打开的文件句柄
125    # （例如 RotatingFileHandler 的日志文件；重复配置会触发 ResourceWarning）
126    for handler in list(root_logger.handlers):
127        root_logger.removeHandler(handler)
128        with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
129            handler.close()
130
131    # 创建格式化器
132    if structured:
133        formatter = logging.Formatter(STRUCTURED_FORMAT)
134    elif verbose:
135        formatter = logging.Formatter(VERBOSE_FORMAT)
136    else:
137        formatter = logging.Formatter(DEFAULT_FORMAT)
138
139    # 添加敏感数据过滤器
140    sensitive_filter = SensitiveDataFilter()
141
142    # 控制台输出
143    console_handler = logging.StreamHandler(sys.stderr)
144    console_handler.setFormatter(formatter)
145    console_handler.addFilter(sensitive_filter)
146    root_logger.addHandler(console_handler)
147
148    # 文件输出（可选）
149    if log_file:
150        log_path = Path(log_file)
151        log_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
152
153        file_handler = RotatingFileHandler(
154            str(log_path),
155            maxBytes=max_bytes,
156            backupCount=backup_count,
157            encoding="utf-8",
158        )
159        file_handler.setFormatter(formatter)
160        file_handler.addFilter(sensitive_filter)
161        root_logger.addHandler(file_handler)
162
163    # 配置 remote_cmd 包日志
164    logging.getLogger("remote_cmd").setLevel(getattr(logging, level.upper(), logging.INFO))
165
166    logging.getLogger("remote_cmd").debug("日志系统已初始化")

class SensitiveDataFilter(logging.Filter): 
52class SensitiveDataFilter(logging.Filter):
53    """
54    日志过滤器：自动脱敏敏感数据
55
56    重写 filter 方法，在日志记录发出前替换敏感字段。
57    """
58
59    def filter(self, record: logging.LogRecord) -> bool:
60        if isinstance(record.msg, str):
61            record.msg = redact_sensitive_data(record.msg)
62        if record.args:
63            # 处理 %s 格式的参数
64            cleaned_args = tuple(
65                redact_sensitive_data(str(a)) if isinstance(a, str) else a for a in record.args
66            )
67            record.args = cleaned_args
68        return True
69
70    @staticmethod
71    def redact_dict(data: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
72        """递归脱敏字典中的敏感字段"""
73        result: dict[str, Any] = {}
74        for key, value in data.items():
75            if key.lower() in SENSITIVE_FIELDS:
76                result[key] = "[REDACTED]"
77            elif isinstance(value, dict):
78                result[key] = SensitiveDataFilter.redact_dict(value)
79            else:
80                result[key] = value
81        return result

def redact_dict(data: dict[str, typing.Any]) -> dict[str, typing.Any]: 
70    @staticmethod
71    def redact_dict(data: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
72        """递归脱敏字典中的敏感字段"""
73        result: dict[str, Any] = {}
74        for key, value in data.items():
75            if key.lower() in SENSITIVE_FIELDS:
76                result[key] = "[REDACTED]"
77            elif isinstance(value, dict):
78                result[key] = SensitiveDataFilter.redact_dict(value)
79            else:
80                result[key] = value
81        return result

def get_logger( name: str, **context: Any) -> logging.Logger | logging.LoggerAdapter[logging.Logger]: 
197def get_logger(
198    name: str, **context: Any
199) -> "logging.Logger | logging.LoggerAdapter[logging.Logger]":
200    """
201    获取带可选上下文的日志器
202
203    用法:
204        >>> log = get_logger(__name__, host="web-server")
205        >>> log.info("测试连接")
206    """
207    logger = logging.getLogger(name)
208    if context:
209        return LoggerAdapter(logger, context)
210    return logger

class SqliteHostRepository(remote_cmd.HostRepository): 
115class SqliteHostRepository(HostRepository):
116    """
117    SQLite 主机仓库
118
119    Args:
120        db_path: SQLite 数据库文件路径
121        migrate_from: JSON 文件路径，用于自动迁移（仅首次使用）
122        auto_create: 是否自动创建表和数据库，默认 True
123        encryption: 可选的凭据加密器（设置后 save() 自动加密 password）
124        busy_timeout_ms: 写锁等待上限（毫秒），默认 5000
125        allow_plaintext_credentials: 明文密码持久化策略（v2.5；默认 None
126            为兼容模式）。三态：
127            - None：允许，但 save() 将要持久化明文密码时发出
128              PlaintextCredentialWarning（兼容 v2.4 及更早）
129            - True：显式允许明文落盘（不再告警）
130            - False：save() 遇到明文密码时抛出 CredentialError
131            v3.0 起默认值计划切换为 False。
132
133    注意: 密码的加密依赖传入 encryption。若直接以明文密码调用 save()
134    且未提供 encryption，明文会被持久化到数据库。请勿绕过 HostService。
135
136    并发：WAL + busy_timeout 处理多进程并发写，适合作为多写入者后端
137    （与 JsonHostRepository 的 single-writer 语义不同）。
138    """
139
140    def __init__(
141        self,
142        db_path: str,
143        migrate_from: Optional[str] = None,
144        auto_create: bool = True,
145        encryption: Optional[CredentialEncryption] = None,
146        busy_timeout_ms: int = DEFAULT_BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS,
147        allow_plaintext_credentials: Optional[bool] = None,
148    ) -> None:
149        self._db_path = db_path
150        self._lock = threading.Lock()
151        self._encryption = encryption
152        self._guard = PasswordGuard(encryption)
153        self._busy_timeout_ms = busy_timeout_ms
154        self._allow_plaintext = allow_plaintext_credentials
155
156        if auto_create:
157            self._init_db()
158
159        if migrate_from:
160            self._maybe_migrate_from_json(migrate_from)
161
162    # ========================================================================
163    # 数据库初始化
164    # ========================================================================
165
166    def _init_db(self) -> None:
167        """初始化数据库：创建表和索引"""
168        with self._txn(write=True) as conn:
169            # profiles 必须先于 hosts 建表（hosts 的 FK 引用 profiles）
170            conn.execute(CREATE_META_SQL)
171            conn.execute(CREATE_PROFILES_SQL)
172            conn.execute(CREATE_RECIPES_SQL)
173            conn.execute(CREATE_TABLE_SQL)
174            self._ensure_hosts_profile_column(conn)
175            for idx_sql in CREATE_INDEXES_SQL:
176                conn.execute(idx_sql)
177            # 设置数据库版本
178            conn.execute(
179                "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO meta (key, value) VALUES (?, ?)",
180                ("db_version", str(DB_VERSION)),
181            )
182            conn.commit()
183        # FK 迁移必须在事务外：PRAGMA foreign_keys 在事务内是 no-op
184        self._ensure_hosts_profile_fk()
185        logger.debug(f"SQLite database initialized: {self._db_path}")
186
187    def _ensure_hosts_profile_column(self, conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:
188        """自动迁移：为 v2.8.0 及更早创建的 hosts 表补充 profile 列。
189
190        v2.8.0 的 SQLite 后端在 save()/行映射中遗漏了 ``Host.profile``，
191        导致 profile 引用被静默丢弃（v2.8.1 修复）。旧库在此通过
192        ``ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN`` 原地升级，已有数据保留。
193        """
194        columns = {row[1] for row in conn.execute("PRAGMA table_info(hosts);").fetchall()}
195        if "profile" not in columns:
196            conn.execute("ALTER TABLE hosts ADD COLUMN profile TEXT;")
197            logger.info("migrated hosts table: added 'profile' column")
198
199    def _ensure_hosts_profile_fk(self) -> None:
200        """自动迁移：为 hosts.profile 添加 ``REFERENCES profiles(name)
201        ON DELETE RESTRICT`` 外键（v2.9）。
202
203        SQLite 不支持对已有表 ADD CONSTRAINT，需按官方推荐的
204        "新表 → 复制 → 删旧表 → 重命名" 流程重建。迁移在事务外先关闭
205        ``foreign_keys``（该 PRAGMA 在事务内为 no-op），并在重建后恢复。
206        """
207        conn = self._get_conn()
208        try:
209            fks = conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_key_list(hosts);").fetchall()
210            if any(row["table"] == "profiles" and row["from"] == "profile" for row in fks):
211                return  # 已是 v3 schema
212            logger.info("migrating hosts table: adding profile foreign key")
213            conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys=OFF;")
214            try:
215                conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE;")
216                conn.execute("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS hosts_new;")
217                conn.execute(CREATE_HOSTS_TABLE_TEMPLATE.format(table="hosts_new"))
218                conn.execute(
219                    """
220                    INSERT INTO hosts_new (name, hostname, username, port, password,
221                                           key_filename, tags, description, profile,
222                                           created_at, updated_at)
223                    SELECT name, hostname, username, port, password,
224                           key_filename, tags, description, profile,
225                           created_at, updated_at
226                    FROM hosts;
227                    """
228                )
229                conn.execute("DROP TABLE hosts;")
230                conn.execute("ALTER TABLE hosts_new RENAME TO hosts;")
231                for idx_sql in CREATE_INDEXES_SQL:
232                    conn.execute(idx_sql)
233                conn.execute("COMMIT;")
234            except BaseException:
235                with contextlib.suppress(sqlite3.Error):
236                    conn.execute("ROLLBACK;")
237                raise
238            finally:
239                with contextlib.suppress(sqlite3.Error):
240                    conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON;")
241        finally:
242            conn.close()
243
244    def _get_conn(self) -> sqlite3.Connection:
245        """获取数据库连接（线程安全）。
246
247        PRAGMA 顺序约定：``busy_timeout`` 必须最先设置——首次并发打开同一
248        数据库文件时，``journal_mode=WAL`` 本身需要短暂排他锁，若 busy
249        handler 尚未生效会立即抛 ``database is locked``（v2.2 多进程回归）。
250
251        注意：SQLite 的 journal_mode 切换不经过 busy handler，即使设置了
252        ``busy_timeout`` 仍会直接返回 SQLITE_BUSY；因此在首次并发切换到
253        WAL 时使用有界重试（上限即 busy_timeout）等待其他连接的短事务结束。
254        """
255        conn = sqlite3.connect(self._db_path, check_same_thread=False)
256        conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
257        # 多进程/多连接写入争用：等待对方事务结束而不是立即失败
258        conn.execute(f"PRAGMA busy_timeout={self._busy_timeout_ms};")
259        self._enable_wal(conn)
260        conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON;")
261        return conn
262
263    def _enable_wal(self, conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:
264        """启用 WAL；对 journal_mode 切换的 SQLITE_BUSY 做有界重试。
265
266        数据库已是 WAL 时该 PRAGMA 只读取模式、不取排他锁，直接返回；
267        仅首次从其他模式切换到 WAL 的竞态需要重试。
268        """
269        deadline = time.monotonic() + self._busy_timeout_ms / 1000.0
270        while True:
271            try:
272                conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL;")
273                return
274            except sqlite3.OperationalError as e:
275                message = str(e).lower()
276                if "locked" not in message and "busy" not in message:
277                    raise
278                if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
279                    raise
280                time.sleep(0.05)
281
282    @contextlib.contextmanager
283    def _txn(self, write: bool = False) -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:
284        """
285        事务 + 连接生命周期上下文
286
287        包装 ``with conn:`` 与 ``conn.close()`` 为单一上下文：
288        - 进入时打开新连接并执行 PRAGMA
289        - ``write=True`` 时以 ``BEGIN IMMEDIATE`` 预先取得写锁（等待受
290          ``busy_timeout`` 约束）；避免 deferred 事务在写升级时因快照过期
291          直接返回 SQLITE_BUSY（busy handler 不适用该场景）
292        - 退出时先 ``conn.__exit__`` 提交/回滚，再 ``conn.close()`` 释放 fd
293
294        解决 ``with self._get_conn() as conn:`` 不自动 close 导致的 fd 累积泄漏
295        （sqlite3.Connection.__exit__ 仅管理事务边界，不释放连接句柄）。
296
297        所有读写操作都应通过 ``with self._lock, self._txn() as conn:`` 使用，
298        保证 ``self._lock`` 串行化的同时每次操作后释放 fd；写操作使用
299        ``self._txn(write=True)``。
300        """
301        conn = self._get_conn()
302        try:
303            if write:
304                conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
305            with conn:  # 事务：commit 或 rollback
306                yield conn
307        finally:
308            conn.close()
309
310    # ========================================================================
311    # JSON 迁移
312    # ========================================================================
313
314    def _maybe_migrate_from_json(self, json_path: str) -> None:
315        """
316        if database is empty and JSON file exists, run migration
317
318        Args:
319            json_path: JSON 文件路径
320        """
321        with self._lock, self._txn() as conn:
322            count = conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM hosts").fetchone()["cnt"]
323            if count > 0:
324                logger.info("database not empty, skipping JSON migration")
325                return
326
327        # 尝试加载 JSON 文件
328        try:
329            from pathlib import Path
330
331            path = Path(json_path)
332            if not path.exists():
333                logger.info(f"JSON file not found, skipping migration: {json_path}")
334                return
335
336            with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
337                raw_data = json.load(f)
338
339            # 解析版本格式
340            version = raw_data.get("version", 1)
341            hosts_data = raw_data.get("hosts", raw_data if version == 1 else {})
342
343            if not isinstance(hosts_data, dict):
344                logger.warning(f"unrecognized JSON format: {json_path}")
345                return
346
347            imported = 0
348            for name, host_dict in hosts_data.items():
349                try:
350                    host = Host.from_dict(host_dict)
351                    self.save(host)
352                    imported += 1
353                except (ValueError, TypeError, KeyError) as e:
354                    logger.warning(f"skipping invalid host '{name}': {e}")
355
356            if imported > 0:
357                logger.info(f"migrated {imported} hosts to SQLite")
358
359        except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError) as e:
360            logger.warning(f"JSON migration failed: {e}")
361
362    # ========================================================================
363    # Repository 接口实现
364    # ========================================================================
365
366    def save(self, host: Host) -> None:
367        """保存或更新主机
368
369        Raises:
370            CredentialError: allow_plaintext_credentials=False 且密码为明文
371        """
372        if not self._guard.enabled:
373            self._enforce_plaintext_policy(host.name, host.password)
374        with self._lock, self._txn(write=True) as conn:
375            tags_json = json.dumps(host.tags or [], ensure_ascii=False)
376            # 配置了加密器时，明文密码先加密再落库
377            password = self._guard.encrypt(host.password)
378            try:
379                conn.execute(
380                    """
381                        INSERT INTO hosts (name, hostname, username, port, password,
382                                           key_filename, tags, description, profile,
383                                           updated_at)
384                        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
385                        ON CONFLICT(name) DO UPDATE SET
386                            hostname = excluded.hostname,
387                            username = excluded.username,
388                            port = excluded.port,
389                            password = excluded.password,
390                            key_filename = excluded.key_filename,
391                            tags = excluded.tags,
392                            description = excluded.description,
393                            profile = excluded.profile,
394                            updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
395                        """,
396                    (
397                        host.name,
398                        host.hostname,
399                        host.username,
400                        host.port,
401                        password,
402                        host.key_filename,
403                        tags_json,
404                        host.description,
405                        host.profile,
406                    ),
407                )
408            except sqlite3.IntegrityError as e:
409                # v2.9：FK ON DELETE RESTRICT 同时要求引用的 profile 存在。
410                # SQLite 在写入时快速失败（JSON 后端仍在解析时报 ConfigError）。
411                raise ValueError(
412                    f"host '{host.name}' references unknown profile {host.profile!r}"
413                ) from e
414            conn.commit()
415
416    def get(self, name: str) -> Host:
417        """按名称获取主机"""
418        with self._lock, self._txn() as conn:
419            row = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM hosts WHERE name = ?", (name,)).fetchone()
420
421        if row is None:
422            raise KeyError(f"Host '{name}' not found")
423
424        return self._row_to_host(row)
425
426    def _enforce_plaintext_policy(self, name: str, password: Optional[str]) -> None:
427        """执行明文密码持久化策略（未配置加密器时）。"""
428        if self._allow_plaintext is True:
429            return
430        if not is_plaintext_password(password):
431            return
432        if self._allow_plaintext is False:
433            raise CredentialError(
434                f"refusing to persist plaintext credential for host '{name}'. "
435                "Pass encryption=... to encrypt at rest, or set "
436                "allow_plaintext_credentials=True to explicitly opt in."
437            )
438        warnings.warn(
439            f"Plaintext credential will be persisted for host '{name}'. "
440            "Pass encryption=... to encrypt at rest, or "
441            "allow_plaintext_credentials=True to suppress this warning "
442            "(v3.0 will reject plaintext persistence by default).",
443            PlaintextCredentialWarning,
444            stacklevel=4,
445        )
446
447    def delete(self, name: str) -> None:
448        """按名称删除主机"""
449        with self._lock, self._txn(write=True) as conn:
450            cursor = conn.execute("DELETE FROM hosts WHERE name = ?", (name,))
451            conn.commit()
452
453        if cursor.rowcount == 0:
454            raise KeyError(f"Host '{name}' not found")
455
456    def list(self, tag: Optional[str] = None) -> list[Host]:
457        """列出主机，可选按标签筛选"""
458        with self._lock, self._txn() as conn:
459            if tag:
460                # 使用 LIKE 匹配 tags JSON 中的标签
461                rows = conn.execute(
462                    "SELECT * FROM hosts WHERE tags LIKE ? ORDER BY name",
463                    (f'%"{tag}"%',),
464                ).fetchall()
465            else:
466                rows = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM hosts ORDER BY name").fetchall()
467
468        return [self._row_to_host(row) for row in rows]
469
470    def list_tags(self) -> builtins.list[str]:
471        """列出所有标签"""
472        with self._lock, self._txn() as conn:
473            rows = conn.execute("SELECT DISTINCT tags FROM hosts WHERE tags IS NOT NULL").fetchall()
474
475        tags_set: set[str] = set()
476        for row in rows:
477            try:
478                tags = json.loads(row["tags"] or "[]")
479                if isinstance(tags, list):
480                    tags_set.update(tags)
481            except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError):
482                pass
483
484        return sorted(tags_set)
485
486    def contains(self, name: str) -> bool:
487        """检查主机是否存在"""
488        with self._lock, self._txn() as conn:
489            row = conn.execute("SELECT 1 FROM hosts WHERE name = ?", (name,)).fetchone()
490
491        return row is not None
492
493    def count(self) -> int:
494        """返回主机数量"""
495        with self._lock, self._txn() as conn:
496            row = conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM hosts").fetchone()
497
498        return row["cnt"] if row else 0
499
500    # ========================================================================
501    # ProfileStore 能力（v2.8）
502    # ========================================================================
503
504    def save_profile(self, profile: HostProfile) -> None:
505        """保存或更新 Profile（即时落库；无凭据字段）。"""
506        tags_json = json.dumps(list(profile.tags or []), ensure_ascii=False)
507        with self._lock, self._txn(write=True) as conn:
508            conn.execute(
509                """
510                    INSERT INTO profiles (name, username, port, key_filename,
511                                          tags, description, updated_at)
512                    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
513                    ON CONFLICT(name) DO UPDATE SET
514                        username = excluded.username,
515                        port = excluded.port,
516                        key_filename = excluded.key_filename,
517                        tags = excluded.tags,
518                        description = excluded.description,
519                        updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
520                    """,
521                (
522                    profile.name,
523                    profile.username,
524                    profile.port,
525                    profile.key_filename,
526                    tags_json,
527                    profile.description,
528                ),
529            )
530            conn.commit()
531
532    def get_profile(self, name: str) -> HostProfile:
533        with self._lock, self._txn() as conn:
534            row = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM profiles WHERE name = ?", (name,)).fetchone()
535
536        if row is None:
537            raise KeyError(f"Profile '{name}' not found")
538        return self._row_to_profile(row)
539
540    def delete_profile(self, name: str) -> None:
541        with self._lock, self._txn(write=True) as conn:
542            try:
543                cursor = conn.execute("DELETE FROM profiles WHERE name = ?", (name,))
544            except sqlite3.IntegrityError as e:
545                # v2.9：FK ON DELETE RESTRICT 阻止删除仍被引用的 profile。
546                # 服务层的引用检查是快速路径；本约束是竞态下的最终保障。
547                raise ValueError(
548                    f"profile '{name}' is still referenced by hosts "
549                    "(foreign key ON DELETE RESTRICT)"
550                ) from e
551            conn.commit()
552
553        if cursor.rowcount == 0:
554            raise KeyError(f"Profile '{name}' not found")
555
556    def list_profiles(self) -> builtins.list[HostProfile]:
557        with self._lock, self._txn() as conn:
558            rows = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM profiles ORDER BY name").fetchall()
559
560        return [self._row_to_profile(row) for row in rows]
561
562    def contains_profile(self, name: str) -> bool:
563        with self._lock, self._txn() as conn:
564            row = conn.execute("SELECT 1 FROM profiles WHERE name = ?", (name,)).fetchone()
565
566        return row is not None
567
568    # ========================================================================
569    # RecipeStore 能力（v2.9）
570    # ========================================================================
571
572    def save_recipe(self, recipe: Recipe) -> None:
573        """保存或更新 Recipe（即时落库）。"""
574        variables_json = json.dumps(
575            {name: var.to_dict() for name, var in recipe.variables.items()},
576            ensure_ascii=False,
577        )
578        tags_json = json.dumps(list(recipe.tags or []), ensure_ascii=False)
579        with self._lock, self._txn(write=True) as conn:
580            conn.execute(
581                """
582                    INSERT INTO recipes (name, command, variables, description,
583                                         tags, updated_at)
584                    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
585                    ON CONFLICT(name) DO UPDATE SET
586                        command = excluded.command,
587                        variables = excluded.variables,
588                        description = excluded.description,
589                        tags = excluded.tags,
590                        updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
591                    """,
592                (
593                    recipe.name,
594                    recipe.command,
595                    variables_json,
596                    recipe.description,
597                    tags_json,
598                ),
599            )
600            conn.commit()
601
602    def get_recipe(self, name: str) -> Recipe:
603        with self._lock, self._txn() as conn:
604            row = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM recipes WHERE name = ?", (name,)).fetchone()
605
606        if row is None:
607            raise KeyError(f"Recipe '{name}' not found")
608        return self._row_to_recipe(row)
609
610    def delete_recipe(self, name: str) -> None:
611        with self._lock, self._txn(write=True) as conn:
612            cursor = conn.execute("DELETE FROM recipes WHERE name = ?", (name,))
613            conn.commit()
614
615        if cursor.rowcount == 0:
616            raise KeyError(f"Recipe '{name}' not found")
617
618    def list_recipes(self) -> builtins.list[Recipe]:
619        with self._lock, self._txn() as conn:
620            rows = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM recipes ORDER BY name").fetchall()
621
622        return [self._row_to_recipe(row) for row in rows]
623
624    def contains_recipe(self, name: str) -> bool:
625        with self._lock, self._txn() as conn:
626            row = conn.execute("SELECT 1 FROM recipes WHERE name = ?", (name,)).fetchone()
627
628        return row is not None
629
630    def _row_to_recipe(self, row: sqlite3.Row) -> Recipe:
631        from remote_cmd.core.recipe import RecipeVariable
632
633        variables: dict[str, RecipeVariable] = {}
634        try:
635            parsed = json.loads(row["variables"] or "{}")
636            if isinstance(parsed, dict):
637                variables = {
638                    name: RecipeVariable.from_dict(var)
639                    for name, var in parsed.items()
640                    if isinstance(var, dict)
641                }
642        except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError, ValueError):
643            pass
644
645        tags: list[str] = []
646        try:
647            parsed_tags = json.loads(row["tags"] or "[]")
648            if isinstance(parsed_tags, list):
649                tags = [t for t in parsed_tags if isinstance(t, str)]
650        except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError):
651            pass
652
653        return Recipe(
654            name=row["name"],
655            command=row["command"],
656            variables=variables,
657            description=row["description"] or "",
658            tags=tags,
659        )
660
661    def _row_to_profile(self, row: sqlite3.Row) -> HostProfile:
662        tags: list[str] = []
663        try:
664            parsed = json.loads(row["tags"] or "[]")
665            if isinstance(parsed, list):
666                tags = [t for t in parsed if isinstance(t, str)]
667        except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError):
668            pass
669
670        return HostProfile(
671            name=row["name"],
672            username=row["username"],
673            port=row["port"],
674            key_filename=row["key_filename"],
675            tags=tags,
676            description=row["description"] or "",
677        )
678
679    def flush(self) -> None:
680        """轻量刷新：执行一次 PASSIVE WAL checkpoint（v2.7 P2.3）。
681
682        SQLite 写入即时生效，本方法是与 JsonHostRepository 对齐的接口。
683
684        v2.7 起不再在每次 flush 执行 ``wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE)``：
685        HostService 的 add/update/remove 每次都会调用 flush，TRUNCATE 会
686        等待所有读者并在 checkpoint 后截断 WAL 文件，造成写放大与读阻塞
687        风险。PASSIVE 不等待、不截断，仅将可安全写回的帧写回数据库；
688        WAL 增长由 SQLite 自动 checkpoint（默认 1000 页）控制。
689        需要主动压缩 WAL 时请调用 :meth:`checkpoint`。
690        """
691        with self._lock, self._txn() as conn:
692            conn.execute("PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(PASSIVE);")
693
694    def checkpoint(self, mode: str = "TRUNCATE") -> None:
695        """执行显式 WAL checkpoint（v2.7 P2.3），用于按需压缩 WAL 文件。
696
697        Args:
698            mode: checkpoint 模式（大小写不敏感）：
699                - ``PASSIVE``：不等待读者、不截断（与 flush 相同）
700                - ``FULL``：等待所有读者完成
701                - ``RESTART``：等待读者完成后重启 WAL 日志
702                - ``TRUNCATE``（默认）：等待读者完成后截断 WAL 文件
703
704        Raises:
705            ValidationError: mode 不在白名单内（防 SQL 注入）
706        """
707        normalized = mode.strip().upper()
708        if normalized not in CHECKPOINT_MODES:
709            raise ValidationError(
710                f"unsupported checkpoint mode: {mode!r} "
711                f"(expected one of: {', '.join(sorted(CHECKPOINT_MODES))})"
712            )
713        with self._lock, self._txn() as conn:
714            conn.execute(f"PRAGMA wal_checkpoint({normalized});")
715
716    # ========================================================================
717    # 扩展方法（非 ABC 接口）
718    # ========================================================================
719
720    def search(self, query: str) -> builtins.list[Host]:
721        """
722        模糊搜索主机
723
724        按名称、主机名、用户名、描述进行模糊匹配。
725
726        Args:
727            query: 搜索关键词
728
729        Returns:
730            List[Host]: 匹配的主机列表
731        """
732        pattern = f"%{query}%"
733        with self._lock, self._txn() as conn:
734            rows = conn.execute(
735                """
736                    SELECT * FROM hosts
737                    WHERE name LIKE ?
738                       OR hostname LIKE ?
739                       OR username LIKE ?
740                       OR description LIKE ?
741                    ORDER BY name
742                    """,
743                (pattern, pattern, pattern, pattern),
744            ).fetchall()
745
746        return [self._row_to_host(row) for row in rows]
747
748    def list_paginated(
749        self,
750        offset: int = 0,
751        limit: int = 20,
752        tag: Optional[str] = None,
753    ) -> tuple[builtins.list[Host], int]:
754        """
755        分页查询主机
756
757        Args:
758            offset: 偏移量
759            limit: 每页数量
760            tag: 可选标签筛选
761
762        Returns:
763            Tuple[List[Host], int]: (主机列表, 总数)
764        """
765        with self._lock, self._txn() as conn:
766            if tag:
767                count_row = conn.execute(
768                    "SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM hosts WHERE tags LIKE ?",
769                    (f'%"{tag}"%',),
770                ).fetchone()
771                total = count_row["cnt"] if count_row else 0
772                rows = conn.execute(
773                    "SELECT * FROM hosts WHERE tags LIKE ? ORDER BY name LIMIT ? OFFSET ?",
774                    (f'%"{tag}"%', limit, offset),
775                ).fetchall()
776            else:
777                count_row = conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM hosts").fetchone()
778                total = count_row["cnt"] if count_row else 0
779                rows = conn.execute(
780                    "SELECT * FROM hosts ORDER BY name LIMIT ? OFFSET ?",
781                    (limit, offset),
782                ).fetchall()
783
784        hosts = [self._row_to_host(row) for row in rows]
785        return hosts, total
786
787    # ========================================================================
788    # 内部辅助
789    # ========================================================================
790
791    def _row_to_host(self, row: sqlite3.Row) -> Host:
792        """
793        将 SQLite 行转换为 Host 对象
794
795        Args:
796            row: SQLite 行对象
797
798        Returns:
799            Host: 主机配置对象
800        """
801        # 解析 tags JSON
802        tags = None
803        try:
804            raw_tags = row["tags"]
805            if raw_tags:
806                parsed = json.loads(raw_tags)
807                if isinstance(parsed, list):
808                    tags = parsed
809        except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError):
810            pass
811
812        # 配置了加密器时解密密码
813        password = row["password"]
814        if self._guard.is_encrypted(password):
815            password = self._guard.decrypt(password)
816            if password is None:
817                logger.warning("failed to decrypt password for host '%s'", row["name"])
818
819        # tags 解析失败时为 None，归一化为空列表（与 Host 构造器默认行为一致）
820        if tags is None:
821            tags = []
822
823        return Host(
824            name=row["name"],
825            hostname=row["hostname"],
826            username=row["username"],
827            port=row["port"],
828            password=password,
829            key_filename=row["key_filename"],
830            tags=tags,
831            description=row["description"] or "",
832            profile=row["profile"],
833        )

SQLite 主机仓库

Args: db_path: SQLite 数据库文件路径 migrate_from: JSON 文件路径，用于自动迁移（仅首次使用） auto_create: 是否自动创建表和数据库，默认 True encryption: 可选的凭据加密器（设置后 save() 自动加密 password） busy_timeout_ms: 写锁等待上限（毫秒），默认 5000 allow_plaintext_credentials: 明文密码持久化策略（v2.5；默认 None 为兼容模式）。三态： - None：允许，但 save() 将要持久化明文密码时发出 PlaintextCredentialWarning（兼容 v2.4 及更早） - True：显式允许明文落盘（不再告警） - False：save() 遇到明文密码时抛出 CredentialError v3.0 起默认值计划切换为 False。

注意: 密码的加密依赖传入 encryption。若直接以明文密码调用 save() 且未提供 encryption，明文会被持久化到数据库。请勿绕过 HostService。

并发：WAL + busy_timeout 处理多进程并发写，适合作为多写入者后端 （与 JsonHostRepository 的 single-writer 语义不同）。

SqliteHostRepository( db_path: str, migrate_from: Optional[str] = None, auto_create: bool = True, encryption: Optional[CredentialEncryption] = None, busy_timeout_ms: int = 5000, allow_plaintext_credentials: Optional[bool] = None) 
140    def __init__(
141        self,
142        db_path: str,
143        migrate_from: Optional[str] = None,
144        auto_create: bool = True,
145        encryption: Optional[CredentialEncryption] = None,
146        busy_timeout_ms: int = DEFAULT_BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS,
147        allow_plaintext_credentials: Optional[bool] = None,
148    ) -> None:
149        self._db_path = db_path
150        self._lock = threading.Lock()
151        self._encryption = encryption
152        self._guard = PasswordGuard(encryption)
153        self._busy_timeout_ms = busy_timeout_ms
154        self._allow_plaintext = allow_plaintext_credentials
155
156        if auto_create:
157            self._init_db()
158
159        if migrate_from:
160            self._maybe_migrate_from_json(migrate_from)
def save(self, host: Host) -> None: 
366    def save(self, host: Host) -> None:
367        """保存或更新主机
368
369        Raises:
370            CredentialError: allow_plaintext_credentials=False 且密码为明文
371        """
372        if not self._guard.enabled:
373            self._enforce_plaintext_policy(host.name, host.password)
374        with self._lock, self._txn(write=True) as conn:
375            tags_json = json.dumps(host.tags or [], ensure_ascii=False)
376            # 配置了加密器时，明文密码先加密再落库
377            password = self._guard.encrypt(host.password)
378            try:
379                conn.execute(
380                    """
381                        INSERT INTO hosts (name, hostname, username, port, password,
382                                           key_filename, tags, description, profile,
383                                           updated_at)
384                        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
385                        ON CONFLICT(name) DO UPDATE SET
386                            hostname = excluded.hostname,
387                            username = excluded.username,
388                            port = excluded.port,
389                            password = excluded.password,
390                            key_filename = excluded.key_filename,
391                            tags = excluded.tags,
392                            description = excluded.description,
393                            profile = excluded.profile,
394                            updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
395                        """,
396                    (
397                        host.name,
398                        host.hostname,
399                        host.username,
400                        host.port,
401                        password,
402                        host.key_filename,
403                        tags_json,
404                        host.description,
405                        host.profile,
406                    ),
407                )
408            except sqlite3.IntegrityError as e:
409                # v2.9：FK ON DELETE RESTRICT 同时要求引用的 profile 存在。
410                # SQLite 在写入时快速失败（JSON 后端仍在解析时报 ConfigError）。
411                raise ValueError(
412                    f"host '{host.name}' references unknown profile {host.profile!r}"
413                ) from e
414            conn.commit()

def delete_profile(self, name: str) -> None: 
540    def delete_profile(self, name: str) -> None:
541        with self._lock, self._txn(write=True) as conn:
542            try:
543                cursor = conn.execute("DELETE FROM profiles WHERE name = ?", (name,))
544            except sqlite3.IntegrityError as e:
545                # v2.9：FK ON DELETE RESTRICT 阻止删除仍被引用的 profile。
546                # 服务层的引用检查是快速路径；本约束是竞态下的最终保障。
547                raise ValueError(
548                    f"profile '{name}' is still referenced by hosts "
549                    "(foreign key ON DELETE RESTRICT)"
550                ) from e
551            conn.commit()
552
553        if cursor.rowcount == 0:
554            raise KeyError(f"Profile '{name}' not found")
